rationale.rates: Loan and securities yields jointly fitted to 9M26 annualized interest using mean FY25 and Sep26 exposures. 5pp spread and 15% relative cash yield are analyst assumptions; no contractual rate buckets available. 50% fast reset and 20% yearly slow reset use shared bill and bond drivers, not sourced maturity fractions. Policy betas .5/.35 estimates; no issuer beta disclosure.
rationale.growth: Nominal GDP (real GDP and CPI combined) plus explicit scenario adjustments; Q4 uses quarter compounding, not full-year growth. Funding borrow elasticity .5, bank deposits proportional to customer deposits, asset and expense growth linked to inflation.
rationale.credit: Observed 9M26 impairment annualized divided by average net loans, not IFRS gross cost of risk; scenario multiplier .65/1/1.5. No forecast gross loan, ECL, NPL or Tier1 where basis unknown.
rationale.tax: 35% of positive incremental PBT, preserves 9M actual tax, all-in assumed Ghana sector levies and corporation tax; no assumed deferred tax credit on losses.
rationale.capital: No new capital/OCI. Statutory reserve only, Act930 s34; payout capped at modeled retained earnings after reserve transfer and gated by CAR proxy buffer, cash upper-bound and nonnegative securities. FY26 no extra payout. Capital proxy anchored to 9M reported CAR using equity/assets; actual eligible capital/RWA unavailable. 80% positive-PAT eligibility stress. No regulatory compliance claim.
rationale.cash: Keep Sep26 combined cash/customer deposit ratio with 2pp downside buffer; securities residual asset allocation, negative securities flagged as unfunded, never fabricate financing. Half-cash sensitivity not actual eligible reserves.
rationale.fx: Small explicitly assumed trading growth sensitivity to annual exchange-rate change; no currency-specific asset/liability positions known; not a modeled FX revaluation.
rationale.bank: Retained deficit remains GHS309.925m at September 2026; no dividend assumed in all scenarios, no further equity injection; preserve observed GHS358.572m FY2025 contribution only in history.
